# @arki/log

> Zero-dependency structured logging for every JavaScript runtime: libraries log, apps configure, templates keep values as fields, records map onto OpenTelemetry. It is not a log shipper.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/log`: The core of @arki/log: loggers, `configure()`, templates, processors, formatters, core sinks and wrappers. `LOG_ERROR_CODES`, `Level`, `LogError`, `MIN_SECRET_LENGTH`, `buffer`, `configure`, `consoleSink`, `createLogging`, `deduplicate`, `dropWhen`, `enrich`, `fingersCrossed`; and 43 more.
- `@arki/log/node`: Node, Bun and Deno sinks (`stdout`, `stderr`, `file`), `fromEnv()` and `asyncContext()` for @arki/log. `asyncContext`, `file`, `fromEnv`, `stderr`, `stdout`.
- `@arki/log/otel`: An OpenTelemetry trace source and log sink for @arki/log. `otelSink`, `otelTrace`.
- `@arki/log/testing`: `fakeLog()`, a test double that captures every log record and asserts on it. `LogAssertionError`, `fakeLog`; types `CapturedRecord`, `FakeLog`, `RecordMatch`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- A library never calls `configure()`. An app calls it once.
- Before `configure()`, only `warn` and above are kept, and only the first 64 records.
- Keep values as fields: `log.info('user {userId}', { userId })`.
- Add `redact([...])` for every field that can hold a secret.
- `fatal` writes. It never ends the process.
